errors.evidence: The description states the XMoE Validating (yellow-green) line has a value of roughly 1.40 at 5 training steps, but the plot shows this value is approximately 1.48. The value 1.40 is the approximate value for the other line (SimSMoE Validating).
The description states the XMoE Validating line has a value of about 1.23 at 19 steps, but the data point at this step is located exactly on the 1.25 grid line.
The description states the XMoE Validating line drops to 1.19 at 20 steps, but the value is closer to 1.20.
The description states the XMoE Validating line ends at approximately 1.17, but the final data point at 49 steps is visibly higher, at approximately 1.18.
